content: Kafka partitions are a sequence of segment files (.log) each with a paired offset .index (and .timeindex); only one active segment per partition is open for append, all older segments are immutable/frozen; a segment rolls to a new active segment on size or age threshold. Index maps logical offset -> byte offset in the .log file, avoiding full-file scans. Directly analogous pattern to the recommended burpsy design: active (buffered, unmapped) segment + sealed (mmap'd, read-only) segments + an offset index.
